label: kizuna_battle_d_01
text: Osu, new kid! You here to do a little shopping?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_02a
text: The school store’s a nice place! They’ve got\neverything you need right here![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_02b
text: Hahaha! So you came to see me, did you?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_03
text: I’m here to check out the sandwiches they’ve got\nfor sale.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_04
text: The school store’s sandwiches taste great and\nhave excellent nutritional balance, too![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_select_04
text: What happened to your intensive training?

label: kizuna_battle_d_05
text: Haha. I guess I’m just not used to it yet. All that\ntraining kind of wore me out![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_06
text: I achieved my goal, anyway, so I’m going to take\na break from sandwich making for a bit![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_07
text: Oh, right. I didn’t tell you what my goal was.\c\nI wanted to pay Nurse Miriam back for everything\nshe does for me. It was my way of saying thanks![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_08
text: She’s so nice and so skilled at what she does.\nI really look up to her![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_09
text: I wanted to try sandwich making so I could be\nskilled at doing something for other people, like\r\nshe is, but I guess I just wasn’t cut out for it.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_10
text: What I am cut out for, though, is being full of\nenergy! So I decided to focus on that instead![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_11
text: Like I said in class, I think people and Pokémon\nshould make their strong points stronger![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_12
text: You really helped me out, new kid! Take this as\nmy way of saying thanks.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_13
text: All right, then! What should I go with today to\nget my protein in?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_d_system_01
text: You formed a close bond with Ms. Dendra!
